hypothesis_zh: 纯文生图材质供体的限幅高频残差经过四种子逐像素中位数后，可以滤除单一供体物体，同时安全增加水面微纹理。
single_variable_zh: 相对被拒绝的单图投影，只改变供体生成方式和残差聚合；程序底图、保护区及其科学结构不变。

prompt_parts.scene_identity: Top-down macro photograph of calm shallow clear blue water, no horizon, no container
prompt_parts.material_goal: fine irregular surface micro-ripples, subtle caustics, small specular highlights, natural water texture
prompt_parts.state_delta: uniform edge-to-edge material sample without organized large waves
prompt_parts.must_preserve: even texture scale, diffuse light, no focal object, no shoreline, no text

negative_artifacts: concentric rings, point sources, emitters, interference diagram, pool tiles, panels, seams, dividing lines, spheres, droplets, text, labels, arrows, user interface, watermark, shoreline, boats, animals, giant waves, frozen plastic, metal, perspective view, horizon, blur
